experimentalType: Strict successor audit of the selected-v8 common-policy Snap Trap owner-prompt native vertical slice; excludes mechanical null/WaitPrompt roots and requires exact prompt settlement in both source-seat orientations

predecessor.finding: V1 observed an exact Snap Trap prompt settlement in the registered source-seat-0 trial, but its gate was permissive: null ResolvePromptAction/WaitPrompt roots could satisfy continuation and it did not require prompt settlement in both source-seat orientations. V1 reported an engine error and zero qualified games.

sourceSeatAllocationRule: candidateSlot A => candidateSeat 0/sourceSeat 1; candidateSlot B => candidateSeat 1/sourceSeat 0

v10b.note: Reuse the exact rank-3/B champion-reference seed from the frozen v10b registration, whose phase-A diagnostic captured the Stunfisk Snap Trap source/prompt join.

v8.note: Reuse the exact rank-3/A champion-reference seed from the selected-v8 prospective registration.

randomnessProtocol.seedReuse: Two previously registered seeds; each seed is attempted from both candidate-seat orientations.

controlProtocol.purpose: Reproduce and settle the captured source-owned prompt through the selected-v8 runDevelopment path, then retain the subsequent owner prompt and root-action sequence.

continuationClassifier.meaningfulOpponentDecision: First subsequent non-mechanical root action by the attacking/opponent seat after the exact Snap Trap response.
continuationClassifier.meaningfulSourceContinuation: First subsequent non-mechanical root action by the source seat after the meaningful opponent action.

evidencePlan.exactPromptJoin: Join source marker promptIdAfterStore/pendingNativePromptId, live Store prompt, owner-policy choice promptId and ResolvePromptAction id/action ordinal.
evidencePlan.ownerInformationBoundary: Retain detached actorObservation contract views at prompt creation and response; no opponent hand/deck, unopened deck or face-down Prize identities.
evidencePlan.responseAndSettlement: Retain ChooseCardsPrompt filter/options, native validation, selected public Energy printing, exact physical reference movement and MoveCardsEffect receipt.
evidencePlan.continuation: Capture the first post-Snap-Trap owner prompt and its response; exclude all null ResolvePromptAction and WaitPrompt roots when finding meaningful opponent/source actions.
evidencePlan.abort: Retain native abort stage, action ordinal/name, acting seat, turn/phase, pending prompt summary and error message.
evidencePlan.endpoint: Classify native terminal, action cap, or engine error. No endpoint is promoted to paper-qualified game evidence.

scopeLimitations: One authenticated Aichi original source rank (rank 3) against one existing candidate 60 (champion-reference).
Two previously registered seeds, each attempted from both candidate-seat orientations; four native attempts total.
Selected-v8 common policy is retained; this strict successor changes only evidence classification and gate requirements.
260 native root actions per attempt; a prompt reached near the cap may leave insufficient room for meaningful continuation.
No deck changes, no Aichi Top 32 matchup estimate, no full-field win-rate inference, and no paper legality certification.
